tools.name: describe
tools.description: Get details about Dataverse tables, columns, relationships, picklist values, records, skills, or apps. Use before querying to confirm logical and lookup column names.

query.description: Table name, record reference, or schema element to describe.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search Dataverse metadata (table schemas, business skills, apps) by keyword.

tools.name: search_data
tools.description: Search records within Dataverse tables using structured or unstructured conditions.

tools.name: read_query
tools.description: Run a Dataverse SQL SELECT query with filters, joins, and aggregations.

tools.name: create_record
tools.description: Create a record in a Dataverse table. Use only after the user confirmed the values. Lookup columns take a JSON string {"relatedTable":"<table>","recordId":"<GUID>"} under the lookup column logical name (not @odata.bind).

item.description: Column values for the new record.

tools.name: update_record
tools.description: Update a record in a Dataverse table. Use only after the user confirmed the change. Lookup columns use the same JSON string format as create_record.

recordId.description: GUID of the record to update.
